sections.Profile:
Big Deal, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation on February 7, 1963, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a playing-card and gambling theme, designed by Steve Kordek. Williams built 1,350 units.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Gambling, Card games, Clowns, Original Theme
sections.Editions: - Big Deal: 1,350 made, released 1963-02-01, model number 279
